Type: low open bookcase
Use: displaying books and decor, console surface; living room, home office, entryway
Style: industrial, mid-century modern, contemporary
Materials: medium-tone wood shelves, dark slim metal frame
Colors: warm medium wood brown, dark charcoal
Shape: long low rectangular frame, staggered offset middle shelves forming a step, thin square tube edges, open on all sides, light and graphic
Feel: crafted, warm, airy, architectural
Goes with: leather, black metal, white or grey walls, warm wood; industrial, loft or mid-century rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Modern Wood and Metal Bookcase, 14"W, Wood and Dark Metal
product.description: A bi-level shelf adds architectural interest to this modern industrial bookcase. Tall and narrow, it's perfect against a wall or behind a sofa, and for holding books, photos and even electronics. Wood and metal give it modern industrial style. 14.2"W x 47.2"D x 31.5"H Fiberboard with elm and metal finish Wood and iron together create a modern industrial piece with hints of rustic Compact design for small spaces No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
